exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members as per e1; no alternates or replacements are mentioned. Excluding others is safe because the charter requires votes from the five members only.

exclusions.name: Remote participation or proxy voting
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence and no remote provision (e4). Excluding remote participation is safe because it is not allowed.

exclusions.name: Postponement by non-sponsor
exclusions.why_safe: Only the sponsor can move postponement (e11). Excluding others is safe because they cannot initiate postponement.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Okonkwo, as sponsor, moves to postpone the item before the vote. The evidence says an item listed for final action is voted on unless its sponsor moves postponement, but it is unknown if Okonkwo will do so.
